description:
Euchre is a classic trickster cards game. It's widely played in the United States and other English-speaking countries where it's also known as Yuker or Euker.

In our trickster Euchre free app, you play with 3d ifferent other players Euchre online, forming 2 teams, and the deck in play consists of the 9, 10, J, Q, K, and A cards. There is always a trump and your objective is to score 10 or more points (the original trickster card game). You get these points in matches with 5 tricks, where the team that scores the most points and tricks wins.

In Euchre Online Trickster Cards, a classic trickster cards game, you play Euchre free just like in real life with addicted players or with friends, choosing between accepting the trump, passing or changing your cards, playing the match with your partner, or going alone. Play the best cards and use the trumps wisely to win the tricks in Euchre.

DIFFERENT EUCHRE'S MODES
Play Euchre online for free against addict players or solo against smart bots.

-  With multiplayer game mode!
